blueprint.context: Sabra Onn was twenty-four in this field in RR 166, a barrel-hand on the second of the two southbound crossings, filling from shafts a man had chalked sweet that morning. She has walked over the centre thirty-one times with brine in the butts.
objectives: Corner Denet with the cost of his own instrument rather than with curiosity
Have him say the centre plainly, in one sentence, at the worst possible place to hear it
Let RR 166 arrive on Sabra as arithmetic, not as grief
Change the chapter's direction without a word of explanation from her

setting.description: The pound after midnight: the trough, the rope over collar fifty-one a hundred and thirty paces out, eight animals at a time, and the count said aloud all night.

blueprint.time_of_day: after midnight, into the fourth watering shift

synopsis: After midnight at the pound, Sabra Onn stops Denet on his way out to fifty-one and puts the question again, with twenty-two blocks behind it. He tells her there is fresh water at the centre, nine to fourteen feet down, and that he has known since the spring.
title: The Fourth Shift
